experiment: Exp T6 (Q34): Neuroimaging TFCE + Empirical-Null Calibration on Real Single-Line Win (PHerc. 0306B)

findings.q34_verdict: Real PHerc. 0306B Line 1 PASSES stroke-bounded TFCE + stroke-width morphology (max_tfce_ratio=11.06, p995_tfce_ratio=39.06, diff_tfce_p99=28.09, retention_max=0.758, width_median_hi_mm=0.346, max_b1=8) while real blank margin, synthetic PHerc. 0125 0.6-1.2 mm dot rows, and synthetic PHerc. 1203 2-4 mm bilateral clouds are ALL rejected. However, unmodified default transverse_stroke_topology(eps=1e-4) FAILS on the zero-clipped display tone map due to logit(1e-4)=-9.21 background floor blowup.

discovered_failure_modes_and_adjustments.explanation: PHerc. 0306B's published display rule clips all pixels below sheet median to d = 0.0 (56.0% of blank margin, 29.3% of Line 1). With default eps=1e-4, logit(1e-4) = -9.21 turns tiny 0.05 papyrus ripples into >6 log-odds swings, inflating null_scale to 5.71 and collapsing single_face_score to 0.0249 (misclassifying real Line 1 as bilateral_cloud_like despite bilateral_suppression_frac=6.50e-05). Linear-scale TFCE (and/or eps >= 0.05 logit floor) completely resolves this.

Real PHerc. 0306B Line 1 strokes sit squarely inside the narrow [0.15, 0.80] mm Greek stroke band (median 0.346 mm at d>=0.7, 0.467 mm at d>=0.5, 0% wide blobs), but exhibit ~2x higher width CV (0.572) than uniform synthetic strokes (<0.28) due to natural pen taper and papyrus weave breaks, and lower b1/b0 density than all-loop synthetic O/Theta/Delta glyphs. Accordingly, Q34 treats Betti b1 loops as a 0.25 corroborating bonus rather than a hard gate so short open-letter single lines pass.

Unbounded TFCE allows 2-4 mm clouds to outscore real PHerc. 0306B Line 1 on peak TFCE (88.61 vs 50.97) because cluster extent e(h)^0.5 grows linearly with blob diameter. Euclidean-disk stroke bounding (max_stroke_width_mm=0.9) suppresses 2-4 mm clouds by 85.5% (retention_max=0.145) while retaining 75.8% of real Line 1 peak TFCE.

provenance.caveat: Published PNG encodes single-face fused display tone d = clip((z - lo)/(hi - lo), 0, 1) (TRACE v3B x v8-306H3) rather than paired raw asc/desc volumes; opposite-face null is taken from an independent on-sheet blank papyrus margin crop of the same PHerc. 0306B surface.
